title: Beat the defender
intro: Most targets are protected. Take the defender away, drag it off its job, or lure a piece onto a bad square, and the target falls.

lessons.title: Remove the defender
lessons.summary: Capture the piece that holds everything together.

steps.text: White wants to mate on h7: the queen and the bishop on d3 both aim there. Only the knight on f6 guards h7.

steps.hint: Which white piece can capture the knight on f6?
steps.ifWrong: Remove the knight that guards h7 first.
steps.ifRight: The knight is gone. Whatever Black takes back with, Qxh7 is mate.

steps.text: Black's queen guards the knight on e4. Remove that guard, then collect the knight.
steps.hint: Trade queens on d4 first. What is left guarding e4 after that?
steps.ifWrong: Capture the defender of e4 first: the queen on d4.
steps.ifRight: The queen trade removed the knight's only defender.

steps.text: Before you attack a piece or a square, ask: what defends it? If you can capture or chase that defender, the target is left alone.

lessons.title: Deflection
lessons.summary: Force a defender away from its job.

steps.text: Black's king on f7 has a job: it guards the bishop on e6. Chase the king away with check, and the bishop is left alone.
Deflect the king with a knight check, then take the bishop.
steps.hint: Which knight check also attacks the bishop on e6?
steps.ifWrong: Give a check that pulls the king away from e6.
steps.ifRight: The king had to step away, and the bishop fell.

lessons.title: Decoy
lessons.summary: Lure the king onto the square where it gets forked.

steps.text: A decoy is a sacrifice that drags a piece onto a bad square. Here the knight would love to fork the king and the queen from e7, but the king is on h8, not g8.
Lure the king to g8, then fork.
steps.hint: Give up the rook on g8. The king has to take it.
steps.ifWrong: Sacrifice the rook with check on g8 first.
steps.ifRight: A rook for the queen: the decoy worked.

steps.text: Another decoy: lure the king onto e8, then take the bishop on c8 with check.
steps.hint: Capture the knight on e8 with check. Where does the king end up?
steps.ifWrong: Start with the capture on e8: it drags the king onto the back rank.
steps.ifRight: The king took on e8 and walked into Rxc8 with check.
